m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read your inherited global doctrine (this skill's references/global-crew.md and references/global-everyone.md), then the project deltas if present: docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md, docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md, plus the handoff at .agent-work/epic-559/r0-lifecycle-repair/LAUNCH_ORDER.md. Verify the handoff is complete (task, intent, scope, exclusions, required evidence, test mode, stop conditions); if incomplete, block and return. Then reproduce BOTH defects before changing anything: run the suite in this worktree and record the count, and read the two named sites. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: crew context + glossary + handoff loaded; handoff complete

both defects reproduced before any change, and their observed behaviour written to BASELINE.md -- the suite count in this worktree, the failure text from a foreign checkout, and what close_work did on a work area carrying a gitignored entry

m1-portable-test.title: The real-worktree test passes from any checkout
m1-portable-test.imperative: Fix tests/test_spine_lifecycle.py::TestWorktreePathForRealWorktree::test_reproduces_this_runs_real_worktree so it no longer depends on running inside a checkout named c3-lifecycle. Keep its INTENT -- confirm the wt_root convention against live git state rather than a hardcoded path. Derive the work id from the checkout under test, or state and enforce the condition under which the test applies. A skip that fires everywhere is not a fix: if you skip, the test must still run and pass somewhere reachable and you must name where. Attest c1 (the precondition) BEFORE start.

postconditions.statement: RED observed: the current test was run from a checkout other than this worktree and seen to fail -- manual attest, recording the failure text
the test no longer names a single work id literally
GREEN: the lifecycle test file passes in this worktree

check.command: env -u SPINE_FILE -u SPINE_SESSION -u SPINE_ENGINE FORCE_COLOR= NO_COLOR=1 python -m pytest -q tests/test_spine_lifecycle.py

constraints: stage by name, never git add -A, and a scoped -A is still -A
do not touch skills/**, .mcp.json, settings.json or docs/agents/*

m2-close-work.title: close_work refuses rather than half-succeeding
m2-close-work.imperative: Fix scripts/spine_lifecycle.py close_work so a real work area -- one containing gitignored entries such as the door's mcp_calls.jsonl and mcp_server_started -- moves cleanly, and so any failure restores what it already moved rather than leaving the work area split across two directories. Preserve spine-last: the spine and its journal move after everything else, which is the property that let C3's interrupted run retry. Write a fixture whose work area contains a gitignored file, because a real one always does -- every existing close_work fixture builds its area with open_work, which never produces one. Then mutate the real source and watch your test refuse; record what you mutated and what it said.

postconditions.statement: RED observed: a fixture work area containing a gitignored entry was seen to fail against the unfixed close_work -- manual attest, recording the failure text
FALSIFIED: the real source was mutated and the new test refused it -- manual attest, naming the mutation and the failure message
GREEN: the lifecycle tests pass, gitignored-entry fixture included

check.command: env -u SPINE_FILE -u SPINE_SESSION -u SPINE_ENGINE FORCE_COLOR= NO_COLOR=1 python -m pytest -q tests/test_spine_lifecycle.py

constraints: do not patch C3's approved code beyond these two defects; a third finding is reported, not fixed
no merge to main; PR #564 is open and the merge is the Admiral's

m3-verify.title: Green from a checkout that is not this worktree
m3-verify.imperative: Prove the tree is green somewhere other than the worktree it was written in -- the exact thing that hid defect 1. c1 creates a detached worktree at HEAD and runs the whole suite there; it is the gate, not a formality. Then run the spine sweep and account for any movement from 23. Write IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.md including its Workflow Feedback section, commit by name, and push to the existing branch. Do not merge PR #564.

postconditions.statement: the full suite passes from a foreign detached checkout at HEAD

check.command: git worktree remove --force ../r0-verify 2>/dev/null; git worktree prune; git worktree add --detach ../r0-verify HEAD && cd ../r0-verify && env -u SPINE_FILE -u SPINE_SESSION -u SPINE_ENGINE FORCE_COLOR= NO_COLOR=1 python -m pytest -q tests

postconditions.statement: the spine sweep still reports 23 fault lines, or the movement is explained in the result
IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.md exists and carries a Workflow Feedback section
